name: Pencil sketch on paper with one coloured protagonist

source.description: 1 inspected reference film (batch-3, 2026-11-26): a launch film draws a business story in pencil on warm paper around one teal protagonist, with a chalkboard negative for its payoff.

technique: Pencil line drawings with visible hatching on warm paper, hand-written notes with arrows and one saturated object as the protagonist. The sketchbook feel makes a business subject feel considered and human, and the single colour leads the eye. Not the same as cut-paper-title-sequence (flat cut shapes popping on beats).
purpose: Make a business or planning subject feel considered and human; one saturated colour leads the eye.
visual_behaviour: Graphite line drawings with hatching on warm paper, hand-written notes with curved arrows and slightly rotated paper cards; one saturated object is the protagonist; the payoff inverts to light lines on a dark chalkboard.
mechanics: Off-white paper texture with a soft vignette; line art in 1-1.5 px graphite grey with hatching; annotations in a hand-written script with curved arrows; one accent colour reserved for the protagonist (teal in ref-2860712d4e); documents as slightly rotated paper cards with soft shadows that settle in 0.3-0.5 s; a negative variant (dark chalkboard, light lines) for the payoff section (5.0-11.4 s).

decomposition.timing: A style system; card entrances 0.3-0.5 s.

parameters.name: accent
parameters.description: The one saturated protagonist colour (project token)

use_cases: Explainers about planning, design or estimating
A warm alternative to flat UI promos
failure_modes: Tracing a reference's drawings instead of drawing original art
More than one saturated colour breaks the single-protagonist read

implementation.approach: Off-white paper texture with a soft vignette; SVG line art at 1-1.5 px in graphite grey with hatching; hand-written annotations with arrows; one accent colour reserved for the protagonist; cards settle with soft shadows in 0.3-0.5 s; a negative variant for the payoff. Draw original art: never trace the reference. Not built as a registered style.

provenance.observed: Pencil-sketched stairs, documents and notes on warm paper around a single teal ball (0-5.0 s), inverted to a chalkboard negative for the payoff (5.0-11.4 s), back to paper for the end card.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown).
